verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Lithic serves a live llms.txt file at docs.lithic.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with structured content, and docs pages also expose markdown-native versions (e.g., mcp.md) explicitly designed for AI agents/editors to consume alongside an MCP server. This directly supports pointing an agent at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that agents actually use llms.txt successfully in practice.
